links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified radiology reports (readability indices before vs after LLM simplification)
links.outcome: Readability of radiology reports measured with four established readability indices
links.effect: All four LLMs (ChatGPT3.5, ChatGPT4.0, Google Bard, Microsoft Bing) significantly simplified the 254 reports; no numeric values given in the abstract; performance varied by prompt and model
links.tradeoff: Improvements are needed to ensure accurate clinical representation and optimal readability
links.quote: All LLMs significantly simplified the reports, but performance varied based on the prompt used and the specific model.

links.comparator_used: Prompts without the added patient-recipient or 7th-grade reading-level context
links.effect: Specifying user as a patient or requesting simplification at the 7th grade level performed best for ChatGPT models; no numerical readability scores reported in the abstract
links.quote: The ChatGPT models performed best when additional context was provided (i.e., specifying user as a patient or requesting simplification at the 7th grade level).
